content: Chapped lips refer to a condition in which the lips become excessively dry and may develop cracks. This condition often occurs due to the loss of moisture from the lips. The application of chapstick or lip balm can offer temporary relief by providing a protective barrier and helping to retain moisture. However, it is important to avoid overusing these products, as excessive application may lead to dependency or reduced natural hydration of the lips. It is also crucial to refrain from licking your lips. While it may seem like a way to hydrate them, saliva evaporates rapidly and can exacerbate dryness, leaving the lips in a worse condition than before.
